name: max.com.gt
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: www.max.com.gt scores 66 out of 100 (D). 6 checks fail now, 35 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 73 elements on /, /cart, /ofertas-web, for example .header-text.flex-row.gap-2 > .lg\:flex.font-bold.hidden and .lg\:flex.header-text.font-bold. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 4 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /marcas, /bodas-max. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /ofertas-web, for example #plp-view-type-mosaic-button and #plp-view-type-list-button. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw TikTok Pixel (14 requests), Google Ads (2 requests), Meta Pixel (1 request), Google Analytics (1 request), and cookies _gcl_au, _ga_MC7GSWEK6L, _ga, _ttp on tiktok.com,…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, for example .z-20 and .lg\:block.hidden > .relative[role="region"][aria-roledescription="carousel"] > .bottom-5.z-10.absolute > .mt-2.gap-x-2.. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, /cart, /ofertas-web, for example .shadow-\[0_8px_24px_rgba\(0\,0\,0\,0\.28\)\] and a[data-testid="footer-app-download-link-test"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
The largest element paints in 1.1 s
Every page has a meta description
